 Central Michigan vs Buffalo Prediction, Top Picks & Odds Tonight: College Football Week 12
 Rob Paul 
 • Betting Analyst 
 5+ years betting experience 
 Updated: 
Nov 18, 2026 , 04:36 PM ET
 • 4 min read 
 Red-hot Buffalo looks to put an exclamation point on its November MACtion run, hunting a sixth consecutive conference win against a predictable, one-dimensional Central Michigan attack.
 Jump to section: 
 Who Will Win 
 Over/Under Pick 
 Prop 
 Combo 
 Odds 
 ncaaf
 Nov 18 • 2:30 PM ET 
 Photo By - Reuters Connect. Central Michigan's Jadyn Glasser (5) and Buffalo's Jason Wright clash in MACtion on Wednesday. 
 With a MAC Championship berth on the line, my Central Michigan vs. Buffalo prediction backs the surging Bulls to cover a tight 1. 5-point spread on home turf. 
 Riding a five-game winning streak, the 7-3 Buffalo Bulls host the 5-5 Central Michigan Chippewas under the Wednesday night MACtion lights at Broadview Stadium in Buffalo, N. Y. (7: 30 p. m. ET, ESPNU). 
 My college football picks are all in on Buffalo to win a low-scoring game at home as a 1.5-point favorite, with the game total sitting at just 45.5 at Kalshi . 
 Central Michigan vs Buffalo prediction 
 Spread prediction: Buffalo -1.5 
 Over/Under prediction: Under 45.5 
 Combo: 6.06x 
  TOP PICK 
Who will win Central Michigan vs Buffalo: Buffalo -1.5 
 Pete Lembo is one of the MAC's most proven coaches, and he's carried the momentum Buffalo built during a hot October into November MACtion. Not only have the Bulls won five straight games, but they've covered the spread in all six MAC games this season, which is why I would play  Buffalo at -3.5 or better .
 This is a tough matchup for a Central Michigan offense that rarely throws the ball and leans heavily on head coach Matt Drinkall's triple-option roots. The Chippewas run the ball nearly twice as much as they throw it (21.5 pass attempts per game vs. 41.3 rush attempts), but the Bulls have a sneaky solid run defense,  ranking 58th nationally in EPA per rush .
 If Buffalo builds a lead, Central Michigan won't be able to throw its way back into the game. The Chippewas average the fifth-fewest passing yards in the country (126.6), and QB Jadyn Glasser leads all of college football in turnover-worthy play rate (8.2%).
 COVERS INTEL: Central Michigan's offense doesn't just match up poorly with Buffalo; its defense does too. The Bulls have one of the Group of Six's best running backs in Messiah Burch (1,110 rushing yards), and the Chippewas rank 136th in rush success rate on D (52.4%). 
 Enjoying Covers content? Add us as a preferred source on your Google account Central Michigan vs Buffalo Over/Under pick: Under 45.5
 Central Michigan may not run a full-fledged triple-option offense, but Drinkall's time coaching at Army has clearly influenced his approach. The Chippewas have hit the Under in seven of 10 games this season, and I like them to do it again with a game total of 45.5 or higher .
 With CMU running the ball as much as it does, it's 123rd nationally in seconds per play (29.1 seconds) , and its inability to throw the ball (108th in EPA per dropback) lends well to the Under... and so does Buffalo's non-existent passing game.
 The Bulls rank 132nd nationally in pass success rate (34.3), and QB Jason Wright has more turnover-worthy plays (16) than TD passes (10). This will be a rock fight.
 Central Michigan vs Buffalo prop: Central Michigan TT Under 23.5
 Against quality MAC opponents, Central Michigan can't score with consistency, so the Chippewas team total Under is playable at 22.5 or better .
 In three matchups against MAC opponents with winning records, Central Michigan is averaging just 18.3 points per game. Buffalo is one of the MAC's top teams and has held conference opponents to fewer than 21 points four times in six games. 
 The Bulls have the third-highest havoc rate in the MAC (16.1%) and are among the best teams in the conference at limiting opponents on money downs, ranking 53rd nationally in third/fourth-down success rate (41.7%).
 Central Michigan vs Buffalo combo
 Buffalo has been a machine in MAC play and hasn't lost since Oct. 3. Head coach Pete Lembo will have his team extra motivated to secure a spot in the conference championship game for the first time since 2020.
 It helps that Central Michigan matches up poorly on both sides, with Buffalo's success running the ball and stopping the run.
 If Wright can play a clean game and lean on Burch and Chance Morrow , the Bulls can take advantage of a Central Michigan team that hasn't played a quality opponent on the road in over a month (a 31-14 loss to Ohio on Oct. 10).
 The Chips have been outscored by an average of 26.6 to 18.3 against MAC opponents with winning records.
 Central Michigan vs Buffalo combo
 Spread: Buffalo -1.5
 Total: Under 45.5
 Team total: Buffalo Over 23.5
